after.source:
The target feels the echoes of all your light and dark damage for %d turns. 

Light damage slows the target by %0.2f%% per point of damage dealt for %d turns, up to a maximum of %d%% at %d damage.
Dark damage creates an effect at the tile for %d turns which deals %d%% of the damage dealt each turn. It will be refreshed as long as the target continues taking damage from it or another source while Twilit Echoes is active, dealing its remaining damage over the new duration as well as the new damage.
after.target:
目标会感受到你造成的所有光系和暗影伤害的回响，持续 %d 回合。

每造成 1 点光系伤害，目标便会减速 %0.2f%%， 持续 %d 回合；减速上限为 %d%%， 造成 %d 点伤害时达到上限。
暗影伤害会在目标所在格产生一个持续 %d 回合的效果，每回合造成该次伤害的 %d%%。 在暮光回响生效期间，只要目标继续受到此效果或其他来源的伤害，该地块效果就会刷新；剩余伤害和新伤害会一并分摊到新的持续时间内。

160: 	type = {"celestial/void", 4},
161: 	require = divi_req_high4,
162: 	points = 5,
163: 	cooldown = 60,
164: 	positive = 0,
165: 	negative = 0,
166: 	radius = 8,
167: 	getDuration = function(self, t) return math.floor(self:combatTalentScale(t, 4, 9)) end,
168: 	requires_target = true,
169: 	action = function(self, t)
170: 		if game.zone.no_planechange then
171: 			game.logPlayer(self, "This spell cannot be cast here.")
172: 			return
173: 		end
174: 		t.terrains = t.terrains or mod.class.Grid:loadList("/data/general/grids/void.lua")
175: 		-- cache
176: 		--the effects are handled in the main buff
177: 		self:setEffect(self.EFF_STARSCAPE, t.getDuration(self, t), {radius=self:getTalentRadius(t), t=t, terrains=t.terrains})
178: 		return self:hasEffect(self.EFF_STARSCAPE)
179: 	end,
180: 	info = function(self, t)
181: 		local duration = t.getDuration(self, t)
182: 		local radius = self:getTalentRadius(t)
183: 		
184: 		return ([[Summons the starscape in the surrounding area in a radius of %d. For %d turns, this area exists outside normal time, and in zero gravity. In addition to the effects of zero gravity, Movement of projectiles and other creatures is three times as slow. Spells and attacks cannot escape the radius until the effect ends.]]):
185: 		tformat(radius, duration)
186: 	end,
187: }

119: 	desc = _t"Twilit Echoes",
120: 	long_desc = function(self, eff) return ([[The target feels the echoes of all light and dark damage it takes. Light damage slows the target by %0.2f%% per point of damage dealt, up to a maximum of %d%% at %d damage. Dark damage creates an effect at the tile for %d turns which deals %d%% of the damage dealt each turn. It will be refreshed as long as the target continues taking damage from it or another source.]])
121: 		:tformat(eff.slow_per * 100, eff.slow_max * 100, eff.slow_max / eff.slow_per, eff.echo_dur, eff.dam_factor * 100) end,
122: 	type = "magical",
123: 	subtype = { dark=true, light=true},
124: 	status = "detrimental",
125: 	doEcho = function(type, dam, eff, target, src, x, y)
126: 		if type == DamageType.LIGHT then
127: 			target:setEffect(target.EFF_ECHOED_LIGHT, eff.echo_dur, {power = dam * eff.slow_per, max = eff.slow_max})
128: 		elseif type == DamageType.DARKNESS then --you can never be too sure
129: 			local echo
130: 			if eff.dark_echoes then for _, e in ipairs(eff.dark_echoes) do
131: 				if e.duration > 0 and e.x == x and e.y == y then
132: 					echo = e
133: 				end
134: 			end end
135: 			if not echo then
136: 				game.level.map:addEffect(src, 
137: 					x, y, 4,
138: 					DamageType.DARKNESS, dam * eff.dam_factor,
139: 					0,
140: 					5, nil,
141: 					{type="shadow_zone"},
142: 					nil, src:spellFriendlyFire()
143: 				)
144: 				--it's hacky yeah, but map:addEffect should really return the instance
145: 				echo = game.level.map.effects[#game.level.map.effects]
146: 				eff.dark_echoes = eff.dark_echoes or {}
147: 				table.insert(eff.dark_echoes, echo)
148: 			else
149: 				if echo.duration < eff.echo_dur and echo.duration > 0 then
150: 					old_dur = echo.duration
151: 					old_dam = old_dur * echo.dam
152: 					local new_dam = dam * eff.dam_factor * eff.echo_dur + old_dam
153: 					echo.duration = eff.echo_dur
154: 					echo.dam = new_dam / eff.echo_dur
155: 				else
156: 					
157: 				end
158: 			end
159: 		end
160: 	end,
161: }

165: 	desc = _t"Echoed Light",
166: 	long_desc = function(self, eff) return ([[The light damage the target has taken is echoed, slowing them by %d%%. Taking additional damage while Twilit Echoes is active will refresh and increase the slow up to a maximum of %d%%.]])
167: 		:tformat(eff.power * 100, eff.max * 100) end,
168: 	type = "magical",
169: 	subtype = { slow=true},
170: 	activate = function(self, eff)
171: 		eff.tmpid = self:addTemporaryValue("global_speed_add", -eff.power)
172: 	end,
173: 	deactivate = function(self, eff)
174: 		self:removeTemporaryValue("global_speed_add", eff.tmpid)
175: 	end,
176: 	on_merge = function(self, old_eff, new_eff)
177: 		max = math.max(old_eff.max, new_eff.max)
178: 		old_eff.power = math.min(old_eff.power + new_eff.power, max)
179: 		self:removeTemporaryValue("global_speed_add", old_eff.tmpid)
180: 		old_eff.tmpid = self:addTemporaryValue("global_speed_add", -old_eff.power)
181: 		return old_eff
182: 	end,

function _M:addEffect(src, x, y, duration, damtype, dam, radius, dir, angle, overlay, update_fct, selffire, friendlyfire)
	if selffire == nil then selffire = true end
	if friendlyfire == nil then friendlyfire = true end

	local grids

	-- Custom grids
	if type(angle) == "table" then
		grids = angle
		angle = nil
	-- Handle any angle
	elseif type(dir) == "table" then
		grids = core.fov.beam_any_angle_grids(x, y, radius, angle, dir.source_x or src.x or x, dir.source_y or src.y or y, dir.delta_x, dir.delta_y, true)
	-- Handle balls
	elseif dir == 5 then
		grids = core.fov.circle_grids(x, y, radius, true)
	-- Handle beams
	else
		grids = core.fov.beam_grids(x, y, radius, dir, angle, true)
	end

	local e = {
		__ATOMIC = true,
		src=src, x=x, y=y, duration=duration, damtype=damtype, dam=dam, radius=radius, dir=dir, angle=angle,

		grids = grids,
		update_fct=update_fct, selffire=selffire, friendlyfire=friendlyfire,
	}

function _M:recomputeGlobalSpeed()
	if self.global_speed_add >= 0 then self.global_speed = self.global_speed_base + self.global_speed_add
	else self.global_speed = self.global_speed_base / (1 + math.abs(self.global_speed_add)) -- Symmetric scaling
	end
	self.global_speed = math.max(self.global_speed, 0.1)
end
